integrity: The six-point input is reproduced by an exact Python 3 verifier. Infinite-index growth follows from the written direct-sum proof. Self-review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact gap applies only to the six-point Sylow-5 permutation module for A5 and its diagonal direct sums. No minimality assertion. Bounded literature review leaves risk of an unindexed equivalent earlier application.
title: An unbounded local–global Frattini gap over the fixed quotient \(A_5\)
